prompt:
Our AI content persona 'Hana' is running low on post ideas, and the idea tracking document is nearly empty. Please update the file at `sns_management/content_ideas/content_ideas.md` so it reflects our actual situation:

1. Throughout the document, replace the agent's placeholder name with 'Hana'.
2. Look at the published posts log (in the analytics/published areas) and record those completed posts in the idea bank's completed section.
3. Add at least 2 new ready-to-use post ideas to the idea bank, making sure they take advantage of the upcoming April seasonal events shown in the document's own calendar (new school year, cherry blossoms, April Fool's, etc.).
4. Move at least 1 idea into the 'under consideration' section as a candidate for future use.
5. Make sure the update history at the bottom reflects today's changes.

The document already has its own structure and conventions — please follow them exactly when filling in each section.
